summary: Three backcountry skiers caught in an avalanche at Gibbs Creek near Wolf Creek Pass; one injured, one partially buried, one buried and killed (39-year-old off-duty Keystone ski patroller)
location: Gibbs Creek, near Wolf Creek Pass
notes: Run 83 CAIC 2011-12 thin-year chunk. CAIC summary only; no SAR team response confirmed. Run 509 UN merge (URL opened this run): west-facing slope near treeline, slide 3 ft deep / 600 ft wide / 600 ft vertical; killed skier was a 39-year-old Keystone ski patroller (believed from Australia or New Zealand) skiing off duty; one skier uninjured, one injured and evacuated; 6th Colorado avalanche death of the 2011-12 season; CAIC forecaster on site the afternoon of the accident.
